_comment: Merge policy. deny_* entries fail the build in strict mode and become warnings in warn mode; hard errors (unidentifiable coordinates, same class path with different bytes) fail in every mode.

deny_groups.org.springframework: Spring Framework / Boot / Security modules must share one version managed by the Boot BOM; freezing one inside a bundle breaks that alignment
deny_groups.com.fasterxml.jackson: Jackson modules must share one version and register through SPI
deny_groups.io.netty: Netty modules must share one version and ship platform native libraries
deny_groups.io.micrometer: Micrometer modules must share one version
deny_groups.org.apache.tomcat: Embedded Tomcat modules must share one version
deny_groups.org.eclipse.jetty: Jetty modules must share one version
deny_groups.org.apache.logging.log4j: Log4j2 modules must share one version and carry custom component metadata
deny_groups.ch.qos.logback: Logging providers must match the SLF4J API
deny_groups.org.slf4j: SLF4J API, providers and bridges must match
deny_groups.org.jetbrains.kotlin: Kotlin standard library modules must share one version
deny_groups.org.jetbrains.kotlinx: Kotlin coroutines / serialization modules must share one version
deny_groups.io.projectreactor: Reactor modules must share one version
deny_groups.org.hibernate: Hibernate modules must share one version
deny_groups.org.bouncycastle: JCE providers must stay signed on Oracle JDKs
deny_groups.io.grpc: gRPC modules must share one version
deny_groups.com.google.protobuf: The protobuf runtime is coupled to the version of the generated code

warn_groups.jakarta: Jakarta API jars are usually managed by the Boot BOM and will no longer follow Boot upgrades once merged
warn_groups.javax: javax API jars are usually managed by the Boot BOM and will no longer follow Boot upgrades once merged

equivalence._comment: Non-dependency entries ignored by the application equivalence check (files that always change on a rebuild)
